decisive_items: Telemetry showed frequent ventricular ectopy triggering ventricular fibrillation
Genetic testing identified no pathogenic variants
response.rationale: Structurally normal heart with no ischemia, no electrolyte disturbance, absent Brugada/early repolarization patterns, normal QTc, and culprit PVC-triggered VF treated by ablation best fits idiopathic ventricular fibrillation rather than CPVT or a channelopathy.

rejected.why: Polymorphic VT from PVCs is present, but there is no stress/effort trigger, no pathogenic variant, and culprit-PVC ablation is not the typical CPVT treatment.
High precordial ECG did not demonstrate Brugada pattern and no Brugada morphology is described.
Follow-up ECG explicitly showed absence of early repolarization pattern.
QTc was 443 ms and 433 ms, both within normal range, so long QT syndrome is not supported.
